WP1.review: All 21 case IDs and seven pinned projects map to proposed APE/PPE/CP, memory and host services. Components are explicitly separate from full experiments.

WP2.review: Select unmodified Tree-sitter C plus JSON after comparing Git, CPython and LLVM scope; freeze source/license and input/independent-output identities. No upstream port patches yet.

WP3.review: Native sizes, allocator/heap data, instrumented branch outcomes and memory locality, observed touched-stack extent, ordered atomic counts, real Git/Clang process/file use and serial critical path. Static RV64 instruction/link audit is supplemental, not execution. PMU misses, contention and worst-case target bounds remain downstream.

WP4.review: PPE-0.1 fixes wave/scalar/vector state, masks, structured reconvergence, barriers, bounded scratch, one-outstanding memory and partial-store faults. Binary allocation/model/RTL are explicitly S02 tasks.

WP5.review: HATS-TASK-0.1 fixes 128-byte descriptors, 64-byte completions, queue epochs/ownership, dependency bounds, engine/context identities, release/acquire and drain. Completion correlation and total scratch overflow reviewed and tested. Stateful permission/CP enforcement is not a codec claim.

WP6.review: Prioritize real code/data capacity, runtime/providers, atomic semantics and error behavior before OoO/cache/tensor sizing. Freeze comparison identities and require native/independent-ISA/RTL parity at their respective gates.

AC1.review: Exact per-case map plus tests, without treating proposed placement as existing acceleration.

AC2.review: 150 checked native/reference/sanitizer runs on ten frozen fixtures; pristine public upstream pins, license notices and independent JSON type/span/depth oracle.

AC3.review: Minimum S02 direct-launch and S05 CP adapter boundaries specified, including memory/fault/completion obligations; follow-ups below remain owned by their original stage issues.

AC4.review: Six phase categories separated. Real local edit/diff/apply/compile/link/test events have serial dependency and wall-clock accounting. Inference/network are unexercised, not assumed cheap or offloadable. No whole-agent acceleration claim.

tasks: Implement verified compiler/runtime providers and explicit startup/ELF/heap/stack/service adapter; strict-link then execute all frozen fixtures on Spike and APE RTL
Freeze original PPE encoding/code object; implement independent model/assembler, SpinalHDL PPE and direct engine adapter with negative trace tests
Design and validate the performance OoO core; measure dynamic stalls/branches before width/ROB/PRF sizing
Measure real cache/branch PMU behavior where available and target memory stalls; validate cache/MSHR/LSQ ordering and coalescing
Establish target stack/heap resource bounds, exhaustion tests and concurrency/atomic ordering, rather than inheriting native watermark values
Implement actual CP queue/dependency/completion state machine including full rings, rejected descriptors, duplicate IDs, stale epochs, timeout/drain and device children
Demonstrate APE-to-PPE-to-APE continuation without a host scheduler substitution
Enforce capability/address-generation checks on every master, pin/copy metadata, handle TOCTOU and invalidation
Specify preemption, faults, syscall/error services and isolation before generated/untrusted code
Implement four-domain near/far topology discovery, allocation/migration and measured HBM/LPDDR placement/coherence
Specify tensor/FP and compiler lowering, execute independently checked inference; no extrapolation from parser profiles
Run authorized model-driven agent/RSI trajectories, larger languages/workloads and concurrent fork/join under fixed quality/evaluation and compute scope
Measure inference/network/compilation/tests/orchestration critical path and equal-quality end-to-end HATS comparison
Close separate RTL, FPGA and physical implementation gates using pinned configurations; no frequency/area/tapeout claims from S01

limits: S01 completion is requirements/native evidence, not runnable upstream software on APE or a completed OoO/PPE/CP processor.
Static I/IM/IMA strict links remain blocked by enumerated providers; target execution belongs to S02.
Compiler probes are not PMU counters; touched stack is not a worst-case target bound; single-thread atomic counts do not measure contention.
All seven upstream agent projects are component/source coverage, not full reproduced experiments.
The local workflow uses deterministic edits, not an LLM. Inference, network, concurrency and full agent-quality evaluation remain unmeasured.
No HATS speedup, CPU:GPU ratio, optimal ROB/cache size, silicon PPA or tapeout readiness follows from these results.
